verdicts.claim: Los Suns jerseys first worn in 2011 as a protest of SB 1070
verdicts.note: Checked live 2026-10-10: Los Suns was made for Noche Latina and worn twice in the 2009-10 regular season. On May 5, 2010, the Suns wore it for Game 2 against San Antonio to protest SB 1070. The earlier fix said May 5, 2010 was the first wearing, which was wrong. Fixed in strategy, uniform and rhythm.

verdicts.claim: Los Suns branding described as 2011-era
verdicts.note: Checked live 2026-10-10: Changed to first worn for Noche Latina in 2009-10, then worn against SB 1070 in May 2010.

verdicts.claim: Heard Hoop Dance Contest overlaps the Feb 19-21 All-Star window
verdicts.note: Checked live: the Heard lists the 37th contest for Feb 6-7, 2027, two weeks before All-Star. Reworded as a relationship window, not an overlap. The brief repeats the overlap claim.

verdicts.claim: Top insight says All-Star lands inside the Heard's hoop dance contest (and the Heard partner idea cites it)
verdicts.note: Hoop Dance is Feb 6-7, 2027, not Feb 19-21. The WM Phoenix Open is also in early February, before All-Star week, not during it. Say the run-up weeks, not the same weekend.

verdicts.claim: Roosevelt Row First Friday art walk runs monthly
verdicts.note: Artlink runs the walk on the first Friday of each month (about 6-10 pm, Roosevelt St closed to cars from Central to 7th, free shuttles). Feb 5, 2027 is a first Friday. Confirm the Feb 2027 format closer to the date.

verdicts.claim: Majerle's Sports Grill downtown is the diehard pre-game spot and still open
verdicts.note: A live search found no 2026 status. The chain's site calls downtown the original location, a 2019 piece shows it operating, and the Old Town (Scottsdale) location is listed as closed. Strategy builds a launch night on it, so call before planning.

verdicts.claim: Barrio Cafe is on Grand Avenue
verdicts.note: Barrio Cafe is on N 16th Street in Midtown/Central Phoenix, not Grand Avenue. Fixed the neighborhood and chef insight. Fanbase and culture already said Central Phoenix.

verdicts.claim: Sam Fox is Phoenix-born
verdicts.note: Birthplace unconfirmed. Changed to Phoenix-based.

verdicts.claim: Macayo's flagship on Central Avenue
verdicts.note: Not sure the Central Avenue flagship is open. Changed to multiple Valley locations, with a note to confirm. The 1946 founding and the chimichanga claim stay as claims.

verdicts.claim: Latino-majority metro
verdicts.note: Metro Phoenix has a large Latino population but not a majority (city roughly 40 percent, county about a third). Youth in South Phoenix and Maryvale skew much higher. Softened in the insight headline and summary. The strategy thesis and scorecard still say "Latino-majority youth base".

verdicts.claim: Latino-majority youth base / Latino-majority

verdicts.note: South Mountain Park is a hiking preserve, not a court site. Replaced with South Phoenix, Maryvale and Mesa park and school courts.

summary: The Phoenix dossiers get the team facts, schedule dates, arena name and All-Star details right. Los Suns was first worn for Noche Latina in 2009-10 and as an SB 1070 protest on May 5, 2010, not 2011, and Barrio Cafe is on 16th Street. The Heard Hoop Dance is Feb 6-7, 2027, confirmed live. The brief needs edits to the hoop dance overlap, the First Friday contact and the Latino-majority line, and it leans on five unverified items.
